messages:
paging-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east: request-queue-length > 75k, GPU pool dynashard-1 at 98% utilization, autoscaler errors (quota:VM_CREATION_RATE_LIMIT). p95=840ms p99=2.8s. Rolling throttles triggering. https://alerts.company/alert/AI-QUE-17385

ophelia_oncall: ack — I'm on it, taking pager. grabbing logs and handoff notes now.

samir_sre: reading autoscaler logs: controller failing to create nodes, cloud returns 429 rate_limit_create. provisioner retries backoff then gives up. seen spike from a marketing campaign hitting /v1/generate.

ophelia_oncall: thanks. immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply emergency rate-limits on customer-tier=free 2) enable fallback model route (gpt-small-quant) for hosted-api-us-east 3) if needed, route high-req customers to dedicated hot-path.

maria_pm: FYI this is affecting a handful of high-volume customers (3 active integrations). any ETA on initial mitigations? customers already reporting timeouts.

samir_sre: applying throttles now. running admin command to set route weight:

```
# reduce free-tier concurrency and shift weight to fallback
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/routing/set_weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"us-east","route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"gpt-canonical":0.3,"gpt-small-quant":0.7}}'
```

ophelia_oncall: throttles pushed. free-tier concurrency lowered by 60%. starting fallback routing.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-update v2025-03-17T20:02 [ophelia_oncall]. CI: green.

samir_sre: also enabling prefix/KV cache for top-10 customer prompt sets (should cut tokens). patching cache-policy: ttl=600, max-prefix=1024.

infra-engr: opened cloud support ticket CS-10432 for VM provisioning quota increase. requested expedited review and temporary quota bump. ticket# CS-10432.

ophelia_oncall: customer impact update: p99 for affected customers dropped from 2.8s -> 1.1s after routing change. queue length trending down from 75k -> 28k in 7m. still seeing creation failures when autoscaler tries to scale beyond burst limit.

maria_pm: posting proactive status to customers + product status page. Please add a short summary we can paste.

samir_sre: pasteable: "We observed a traffic surge tied to a marketing campaign that caused our US-East hosted endpoint to exceed provisioned GPU capacity. We throttled non-essential traffic and routed inference to a smaller quantized variant to restore latency. Engineers are working with cloud provider to raise provisioning rates. Next update in 30m."

ophelia_oncall: adding workaround to runbook: if autoscaler returns rate limit 429, set route fallback and throttle non-SLA traffic, then open cloud ticket.

alerts-bot: Incident note created: INCIDENT-2025-173850 - 'dynashard autoscale provisioning failure -> hosted queue growth'. severity: high. oncall: ophelia_oncall.

infra-engr: cloud liaised back: can raise create-per-minute to +50 for 2 hours if we provide justification and region. doing now.

ophelia_oncall: temporary quota bump in progress; will watch for node attach events. if successful we can gradually relax throttles.

samir_sre: node attach confirmed at +16 nodes; queue dropped to 12k; p95 stable ~350ms. leaving fallback in place for another 10m before rollback.

maria_pm: sending update to customers now. thanks team.

ophelia_oncall: postmortem action items: 1) add autoscaler exponential fallback to lower-cost variants automatically 2) add pre-approved cloud rapid-provisioning buffer for marketing-heavy customers 3) refine alert thresholds to include provisioner rate-limit metrics.

ophelia_oncall: handing back to next oncall @samir_sre for monitoring through the night. closing pager for me. :thumbsup:
